title: Microsoft Teams: Local PTZ camera controls for Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android
description: If the camera is not currently auto-framing the room, in-room users can now control the Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) of the active camera to keep the focus where they want it.
